component.name: FocusFlow
component.summary: Deep focus sessions with real local app blocking

description.p: FocusFlow is a local-first focus timer and distraction blocker for Linux. It combines focus sessions, task planning, schedules, application blocking, website blocking, allowances, notes, habits, and reports.
Enforcement depends on the desktop session and the permissions granted by the operating system. X11, XWayland, and native Wayland are tested as separate environments.
Linux packaging, enforcement, desktop-session, and release-readiness improvements.
